{{Quote|That? 'Etude for Dawn,' the Sixteenth Vissëncant Variation. Good to see you've become a classical music fan at last, my lead-eared friend.|Zan Yant, to Jos Vondar|<ref name="MedStar I" />}}
'''"Etude for Dawn"''' was a [[Music/Legends|song]] that the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] musician and surgeon [[Zan Yant]] claimed to exist and have been sixteenth [[Vissëncant Variations|Vissëncant Variation]] to see if [[Jos Vondar]] knew that there were only fifteen Vissëncant Variations. In fact, he played the [[Cold Midnight]] by [[Duskin re Lemte]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
